Done! 🎯 I've successfully built the roster table for the Hero Ops Console. Here's what was implemented:

## Roster Implementation Complete

### Files Created:
- **`src/app/heroes/roster.view-model.ts`** — Handles search, filtering, and sorting with computed signals
- **`src/app/heroes/heroes.ts`** — Roster component with filter bar, table, and mobile cards
- **`src/app/heroes/heroes.css`** — Styling for search icon positioning using design tokens

### Updated:
- **`src/app/app.config.ts`** — Registered `lucidePencil` and `lucideTrash2` icons

### What Works:
✅ **Filter bar**: Search input (name/alias/ID) + class dropdown  
✅ **Desktop table**: Columns for Hero, Class, Power, Status, Clearance, Actions  
✅ **Mobile view**: Stacked cards at <640px (option b from spec—nicer than overflow)  
✅ **Summary footer**: Hero count and "sorted by power" label  
✅ **Responsive**: Passes at 375px, 768px, 1280px (Part 5 gate)  
✅ **Spartan primitives**: No hand-rolled controls, no appearance classes on primitives  
✅ **MVVM pattern**: ViewModel holds all logic, component stays thin  

### Gate Status:
✅ **Sealing**: 81/81 tests passing  
✅ **Layout grammar**: PASS  
✅ **Responsive**: PASS (all three breakpoints)  
✅ **Build**: SUCCESS—no errors, app compiles clean

The roster table is production-ready and fully compliant with the build spec, house rules, and all Part 1-5 gates.
